text.p: Italian bond futures erased earlier losses, which reflected weakness in bunds, to move higher helped by the firmer lira and dollar, with many investors on hold until Italian inflation figures next week, dealers said.

They added that the market was watching currency today with domestically-driven action subdued by the wait both for preliminary September CPI data from 10 sample cities on Monday and Tuesday, and for the 1997 budget package to be presented to parliament by the end of the month.
Official figures on Italian wholesale and producer prices released earlier in the day had little market impact.
